about.title: About
about.bio:
Fehintola Onabanjo is a Nigerian gospel minister, worship leader and recording artist. Her Yoruba and English gospel songs, including Omo Baba, Iji Aye and the albums Itura and Ara Edide, carry one message: salvation and new life in Jesus Christ.

She ministers at live worship programmes across Nigeria alongside other gospel ministers, and shares her music, ministrations and ministry updates on YouTube and social media.
